pr.title: fix(etag): fallback if `res.clone()` is not supported

summary: This PR adds a fallback mechanism for environments where `res.clone()` is not supported (e.g., AWS Lambda). When `res.clone()` throws an error, the middleware falls back to calling `res.arrayBuffer()` to read the entire response body into memory, then generates the ETag from the buffer. The signature of `generateDigest` is updated to accept both ReadableStream and ArrayBuffer inputs. A test is added for the fallback case.

findings.rationale: When `res.arrayBuffer()` is called in the fallback path (line 101), if it throws an error (not just `res.clone()`), the error will propagate uncaught. The catch block broadly catches any error from `res.clone()`, but then assumes `res.arrayBuffer()` will succeed. In a truly broken environment, this could fail silently or crash the middleware.
findings.suggestedCheck: Verify that AWS Lambda and similar environments where `clone()` fails do support `arrayBuffer()`, or add nested error handling for the fallback path.
